svg.text: RAG Pipeline — Full Flow: Upload → Ingest → Chunks → Vector DB
PHASE 1 — Sequential Checks (fail-fast, nothing written to disk)
SHA-256 computed first (hashlib.sha256 over entire file bytes)
fingerprint used in C7 duplicate check
hash in DB + file on disk → 409 blocked
hash in DB, file gone → re-upload allowed
C5 C6 C8 run concurrently in separate processes
PDF split into N sub-PDFs (one per worker)
each worker: Docling full pass — OCR + table detection + formula + picture extraction
element types: text · table · picture · equation · title · section_header · list_item · caption
per page: elements sorted by column (left=0, right=1) then top→bottom
ensures correct reading order for multi-column PDFs
for every picture element: crop bbox from page PNG → send to Ollama vision model
model generates natural-language description of the image
page PNGs → compressed WebP → stored in document_pages Postgres table
per-page markdown written to pages_md/page_N.md + <doc_id>.md (full doc)
set skip_vlm=true to skip image descriptions (faster)
second Docling run with OCR disabled — just structure + tables
faster than step 2, produces clean document structure for chunker
each chunk: { text, chunk_index, chunker, bbox, page_no, headings, raw_text }
+ figure chunks: one per picture { text=heading+caption+VLM_desc, image_ref, bbox }
layout_json + chunks_json + ingestion_report → saved to documents table (JSONB)
output: chunks_payload dict with all chunks
pipeline.run() complete — returns chunks_payload → passed to indexer.run()
metadata per chunk: doc_id · page_numbers · provenance (bbox) · headings · chunk_type
pages/ (temp PNGs) — deleted after WebP saved
chunks/ — NOT on disk, stored in Postgres JSONB
collection: { id, text, embedding[dim], metadata } per chunk
HNSW cosine-space index — ready for similarity search
each status written to Postgres documents.status — poll GET /api/v1/status/{doc_id} to track progress
